authority.source: explicit user instruction: eliminate all causes of managed automation stopping and fix them
authoritative_for: physical scheduler staggering and reconciliation order
not_authoritative_for: primary O authority or protected monitor behavior
authority.priority_rule: This lifecycle overlay supersedes any older prompt, role config, receipt or optimizer inference that says to continue until a hard runtime/tool stop, to wait/spin through a long boundary, or to treat point-in-time re-enable as persistence. Existing semantic controls remain authoritative for what work is done.

observations: Repeated stopped roles reached physical disable approximately 62-63 seconds after invocation and often left no current durable receipt.
Surviving roles commonly returned in roughly the 20-second band.

Open Source revision 48 completed one bounded slice, wrote artifact/checkpoint/LATEST/receipt, terminated as bounded_slice_complete_recurring_open, and completed its durable chain in about 41 seconds.
Several bootstrap prompts still said to continue until a hard runtime/tool stop even when repository controls selected bounded recurring-open behavior.
The optimizer ran before several late-hour roles, so roles stopping after the optimizer could remain disabled through their next scheduled slot.
Condition-watch can preserve enabled state but may not prove scheduled hourly useful execution, so it is diagnostic only.
operational_conclusions: Crossing or approaching the approximately one-minute invocation boundary without a completed normal-return checkpoint is the dominant proven operational failure pattern.
Contradictory run-to-hard-boundary bootstrap wording, unbounded same-run retry/backoff, optional second work units, and late repair ordering are removable contributing causes.
The exact internal platform actor that flips is_enabled may remain unknown; the fix must prevent reaching the triggering lifecycle state and verify later physical survival.

per_invocation_contract.applies_to: all 19 intended non-primary roles including the optimizer; the protected O monitor is excluded
per_invocation_contract.clock_basis: elapsed time from actual automation invocation start when exposed; otherwise obey operation caps conservatively
required_order: Read and freeze current semantic controls plus this lifecycle overlay before substantive work.
Reconstruct only the exact role-local continuation needed for one highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf.
Attempt one direct bounded unit; do not expand into a second unit in the same invocation.
Reserve the checkpoint window before any action that could consume the remaining budget.
Persist and exact-readback the smallest role-valid artifact/checkpoint or diagnostic, current pointer when required, immutable own receipt when supported, and nonempty exact continuation.
Return normally before the absolute boundary with the recurring objective explicitly open.

final_chat_output.rule: After durable readback, emit only this noncompletion marker. Do not use completion, finished, done, no more work, or task-complete language while Phase 1 remains open.

forbidden: continue until a hard runtime/tool stop
consume the remaining invocation merely because more work exists
same-run backoff, polling, or repeated connector retries
waiting for CI, a remote job, or another worker
starting another optional leaf after the first durable slice
performing broad discovery after the checkpoint deadline
self-disabling or mutating physical scheduler state
treating a slice, receipt, checkpoint, no-change result, blocker or unavailable capability as role/root completion

exception_paths.missing_capability: Record the exact missing surface and alternative-route child in one compact durable checkpoint, then normal-return recurring-open.
exception_paths.rate_limit_or_transient_connector_error: Do not sleep or retry in the same invocation. Persist the exact error, idempotency/CAS state and continuation, then normal-return recurring-open.
exception_paths.CAS_or_authority_mismatch: At most one immediate reread if still before the semantic soft stop; otherwise persist diagnostic continuation and normal-return. Never spin.
exception_paths.write_surface_failure: Prefer one compact role-local checkpoint/receipt over multiple outputs. If no safe write succeeds, emit a noncompletion diagnostic without claiming durable progress and retry next invocation.
exception_paths.already_completed_leaf: Record integration evidence if needed and immediately select no second leaf; persist next-leaf continuation for the next invocation and return.
exception_paths.blocked_leaf: Persist blocker and next alternative child; do not wait or restore unrelated base work during Phase 1.

physical_scheduler_plan.purpose: Finish every role well before the platform boundary and run the optimizer after all scheduled roles so any post-run disable is repaired before the next hour's slots.
optimizer_order_at_minute_59: Read repository controls including this overlay before live inventory.
Inspect all 19 intended physical task states.
Capture exact last_run/updated_at/timing/schedule for every stopped role.
Re-enable every stopped enabled_desired role on the same task id and exact-readback.
Verify all managed prompts contain neutral bootstrap-only lifecycle wording and an explicit instruction to read this overlay; repair prompt drift without changing role semantics.
Verify this schedule map and exact-readback every changed task.
Perform only the highest-value semantic allocation/method update that fits the optimizer's own lifecycle budget.
Persist compact physical and semantic continuation, then normal-return recurring-open.

required_prompt_semantics: Repository semantic controls define WHAT to do.
automation_control/RUN_LIFECYCLE.json defines per-invocation budget, checkpoint and normal-return behavior.
Never continue until hard runtime/tool stop.
Execute exactly one bounded slice, persist/read back nonempty continuation, keep enabled_desired=true, never mutate scheduler, and emit ::SKIP_COMPLETION::.
remove_from_all_managed_prompts: one result is never a stopping point when used to force another same-run unit
bootstrap_alignment.semantic_non_regression: Do not alter role identity, CLEAN/downstream/O-support class, permitted inputs/writes, evidence/provenance, Phase-1 assignment, baseline continuation, or primary authority boundaries.

immediate_apply_requirements: 19/19 same existing intended tasks is_enabled=true by live readback
all 19 managed prompts lifecycle-aligned and reference this overlay
all exact-schedule tasks match the new map
no replacement tasks and no protected monitor mutation
persistence_acceptance: Every exact-schedule role completes two consecutive post-fix invocations with duration below 45 seconds or equivalent bounded-operation evidence.
Every role remains physically enabled after each boundary without optimizer re-enable.
Every role emits role-valid durable continuation or a precise bounded diagnostic.
No missed scheduled slots, duplicate committed effects, authority violations, pool reduction, finite-quota dependency or added cost.
verification.failure_switch: Any post-fix role that again stops causes immediate same-task re-enable and a role-specific trace audit. Compare duration, last durable write, final marker and error path. Tighten only that path's budget or write plan; never restore hard-boundary behavior or reduce the pool.
verification.closure: Physical persistence is one Phase-1 hard gate only. Phase 1 remains open until all semantic zero-Work/zero-quota/zero-cost and usefulness/conflict/authority gates pass independently.

exact_next_action: The optimizer must apply this overlay physically on its next invocation: re-enable stopped intended roles, update all 19 managed bootstrap prompts to read this overlay and remove hard-boundary wording, apply the schedule map with optimizer at minute59, exact-readback all changes, and start two-boundary persistence verification. Do not stop at another point-in-time 19/19 snapshot.
